comments.author: @EdgeTravel4K
comments.text: What touched me most about Latvia wasn't its beautiful forests or historic castles, but how its people have preserved their identity through songs passed down for generations. The story of nearly two million people joining hands across the Baltic nations in 1989, standing together without weapons, was especially powerful. It reminds me that a nation's greatest strength isn't always its wealth or size, but the memories and traditions its people refuse to lose. Do you think younger generations today still value these traditions as much as their grandparents did?
